# Billboard
> Music charts, industry news, artist interviews, and entertainment coverage from Billboard.

Billboard covers the music business and popular culture through chart rankings, breaking news, features, reviews, videos, and event coverage. Its site is organized around charts, music verticals, culture, awards, business reporting, and multimedia.

## Charts
- [Charts](https://www.billboard.com/charts/): Main hub for Billboard’s chart rankings across songs, albums, artists, and genres.
- [Billboard Hot 100](https://www.billboard.com/charts/hot-100/): Weekly ranking of the most popular songs in the United States.
- [Billboard 200](https://www.billboard.com/charts/billboard-200/): Weekly ranking of the most popular albums in the United States.
- [Artist 100](https://www.billboard.com/charts/artist-100/): Weekly ranking measuring overall artist activity and popularity.
- [Global 200](https://www.billboard.com/charts/billboard-global-200/): Weekly ranking of top songs based on worldwide consumption.
- [Global Excl. U.S.](https://www.billboard.com/charts/billboard-global-excl-us/): Weekly ranking of top songs outside the United States.
- [Streaming Songs](https://www.billboard.com/charts/streaming-songs/): Weekly ranking of the most-streamed songs in the United States.
- [Radio Songs](https://www.billboard.com/charts/radio-songs/): Weekly ranking of songs by U.S. radio airplay audience impressions.

## Music News
- [Music](https://www.billboard.com/music/): Main music coverage hub for artist news, releases, charts, and features.
- [Music News](https://www.billboard.com/music/music-news/): Breaking news and reporting on artists, releases, and industry developments.
- [Pop](https://www.billboard.com/music/pop/): Coverage of pop artists, releases, chart moves, and interviews.
- [Rock](https://www.billboard.com/music/rock/): Coverage of rock artists, tours, releases, and chart performance.
- [Country](https://www.billboard.com/music/country/): Coverage of country music news, artists, releases, and events.
- [R&B/Hip-Hop](https://www.billboard.com/music/rb-hip-hop/): Coverage of R&B and hip-hop artists, releases, and trends.
- [Dance](https://www.billboard.com/music/dance/): Coverage of dance and electronic music artists, releases, and festivals.
- [Alternative](https://www.billboard.com/music/alternative/): Coverage of alternative music artists, releases, and scene developments.

## Genre & Regional Coverage
- [Latin](https://www.billboard.com/music/latin/): News, charts, interviews, and features focused on Latin music.
- [K-Pop](https://www.billboard.com/music/k-pop/): Coverage of K-pop artists, releases, fandom, and chart activity.
- [Afrobeats](https://www.billboard.com/music/afrobeats/): Coverage of Afrobeats artists, releases, and global growth.
- [Jazz/Blues](https://www.billboard.com/music/jazz-blues/): Coverage of jazz and blues artists, releases, and events.
- [Christian](https://www.billboard.com/music/christian/): Coverage of Christian music artists, releases, and charts.
- [Latin Women in Music](https://www.billboard.com/t/latin-women-in-music/): Tag hub for Billboard’s Latin Women in Music coverage.
- [Pride](https://www.billboard.com/t/pride/): Coverage of LGBTQ artists, culture, and Pride-related music stories.

## Business & Industry
- [Business](https://www.billboard.com/business/): Reporting on the music business, labels, streaming, touring, and executives.
- [Business News](https://www.billboard.com/business/business-news/): News coverage of deals, companies, policy, and market developments.
- [Executive Turntable](https://www.billboard.com/t/executive-turntable/): Recurring coverage of executive hires, promotions, and industry moves.
- [Chart Beat](https://www.billboard.com/t/chart-beat/): Analysis and reporting on chart milestones and performance trends.
- [Legal and Management](https://www.billboard.com/business/legal-and-management/): Coverage of lawsuits, rights, management, and policy issues.
- [Publishing](https://www.billboard.com/business/publishing/): Reporting on music publishing, song rights, and royalty developments.
- [Streaming](https://www.billboard.com/business/streaming/): Coverage of streaming platforms, strategy, and consumption trends.
- [Touring](https://www.billboard.com/business/touring/): Reporting on tours, ticketing, venues, and live music economics.

## Awards & Events
- [Awards](https://www.billboard.com/c/awards/): Hub for Billboard and industry awards coverage, nominees, and winners.
- [Billboard Music Awards](https://www.billboard.com/t/billboard-music-awards/): Coverage of the Billboard Music Awards, performances, and winners.
- [Women in Music](https://www.billboard.com/t/women-in-music/): Coverage of Billboard’s Women in Music franchise and honorees.
- [Latin Music Week](https://www.billboard.com/t/latin-music-week/): Coverage of Billboard Latin Music Week panels, performances, and announcements.
- [Billboard Latin Music Awards](https://www.billboard.com/t/billboard-latin-music-awards/): Coverage of nominees, winners, and performances from the awards show.
- [Power 100](https://www.billboard.com/t/power-100/): Coverage of Billboard’s annual ranking of music industry power players.
- [Grammy Awards](https://www.billboard.com/t/grammy-awards/): Billboard coverage of Grammy nominations, winners, and performances.

## Culture & Entertainment
- [Culture](https://www.billboard.com/culture/): Coverage of film, television, style, and broader entertainment culture.
- [TV/Film](https://www.billboard.com/culture/tv-film/): Reporting on music-related film, television, and screen projects.
- [Lifestyle](https://www.billboard.com/culture/lifestyle/): Features on style, wellness, events, and artist lifestyle topics.
- [Books](https://www.billboard.com/culture/books/): Coverage of books, memoirs, and publishing tied to music and artists.
- [Product Recommendations](https://www.billboard.com/culture/product-recommendations/): Shopping and product recommendation coverage tied to entertainment and lifestyle.
- [Pride](https://www.billboard.com/t/pride/): Culture and music coverage centered on LGBTQ communities and artists.

## Lists, Features & Editorial Franchises
- [Lists](https://www.billboard.com/lists/): Ranked features, editorial packages, and best-of roundups across music and culture.
- [Cover Stories](https://www.billboard.com/t/cover-story/): Billboard cover profiles and major artist feature packages.
- [Greatest Pop Stars](https://www.billboard.com/t/greatest-pop-stars/): Editorial franchise ranking and analyzing major pop artists.
- [Staff List](https://www.billboard.com/t/staff-list/): Tag hub for Billboard staff-curated list features.
- [Must-Hear Music](https://www.billboard.com/t/must-hear-music/): Editorial picks highlighting notable new releases to hear.
- [Chart Rewind](https://www.billboard.com/t/chart-rewind/): Retrospective chart analysis and historical chart features.

## Video & Multimedia
- [Video](https://www.billboard.com/video/): Billboard’s video hub for interviews, performances, and original series.
- [News](https://www.billboard.com/v/news/): Video news clips covering artists, charts, and entertainment stories.
- [Interviews](https://www.billboard.com/v/interviews/): Video interviews with artists, executives, and cultural figures.
- [Trending](https://www.billboard.com/v/trending/): Popular and timely Billboard video coverage.
- [Series](https://www.billboard.com/v/series/): Original recurring Billboard video franchises and episodic content.
- [Photos](https://www.billboard.com/photos/): Photo galleries from performances, red carpets, and editorial shoots.

## Newsletters & Magazine
- [Newsletters](https://www.billboard.com/newsletters/): Sign-up hub for Billboard editorial newsletters and recurring updates.
- [Magazine](https://www.billboard.com/magazine/): Billboard magazine hub for print-related features and issue content.
- [Issue Archive](https://www.billboard.com/t/magazine/): Tag hub for magazine-related stories and issue packages.
- [Subscribe](https://www.billboard.com/subscribe/): Subscription page for Billboard’s premium and magazine offerings.

## About & Utility
- [About Billboard](https://www.billboard.com/about-us/): Overview of Billboard as a publication and media brand.
- [Contact Us](https://www.billboard.com/contact-us/): Contact information and inquiry options for the publication.
- [Advertise](https://www.billboard.com/advertise/): Information for advertising and brand partnership inquiries.
- [Accessibility Statement](https://www.billboard.com/accessibility-statement/): Accessibility information for Billboard’s website and services.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.billboard.com/privacy-policy/): Privacy practices and data handling terms for site users.
- [Terms of Use](https://www.billboard.com/terms-of-use/): Legal terms governing use of Billboard’s website and content.
